raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
#42486 switched the default Q/K L2 norm in `fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update` to "compute `1 / sqrt(...)`, then multiply", but `fused_kda_conv_recurrent_verify` still computes `b_q / sqrt(...)`. `x / y` and `x * (1 / y)` round differently, so the fused verify kernel stopped matching its reference bit for bit, and the ROCm-only `test_glm_fp32_weights_bit_exact_on_rocm[8,9]` fails on MI35x:

```
assert torch.equal(ic_fus[valid], ic_ref[valid])
AssertionError: assert False
```

https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38317177892/job/115041491933

The test's `_run_reference` is `causal_conv1d_update` + `fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update`, so this switches the fused kernel to the same reciprocal form, with the same order of operations. The case only runs on ROCm, which is why #42486's validation reports "2 ROCm-only cases skipped".

The other KDA failure on ROCm (`TestKDAVerifyDecodeParity`) has an unrelated cause and is fixed separately in #44089.

## Notes for the reviewer

This changes the fused verify kernel's numerics on every platform, not just ROCm, by moving it onto the form its reference already uses. `fused_recurrent.py`, `gdn_replayssm_spec_{decode,fold}.py` and `kda_replayssm_spec_decode.py` still divide. I left them alone because no test compares them bit for bit against `fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update`.

## Test plan

Locally on MI355X (gfx950), `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x-20261007`:

- [x] `test_glm_fp32_weights_bit_exact_on_rocm`: 2 failed → 2 passed
- [x] Full `test_fused_kda_conv_recurrent_verify.py`: 25 passed, 1 skipped (CUDA green contexts)

CI, `test_fused_kda_conv_recurrent_verify.py`:

- [x] MI35x, `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` part 0, the partition that failed on it before: passed on the [current head](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38519810686/job/115714219438) and [before the main merge](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38355361655/job/115164272858)
- [x] NVIDIA, `jit-kernel-unit-test-1-gpu-large`: passed on the [current head](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38519810721/job/115706908811) and [before the main merge](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38355361603/job/115157428852). This is the change in the pair that affects NVIDIA

## Remaining red checks

- `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd` part 2 fails `TestKDAVerifyDecodeParity.test_bf16_state_verify_matches_single_token_launches` ([log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38519810686/job/115714219452)). That is the other half of the KDA ROCm fix, in #44089.
- CUDA base-b stops at `vlm/test_unlimited_ocr_server.py`, which can't load `baidu/Unlimited-OCR` without `trust_remote_code` ([log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38519810721/job/115719715621)). The other base-b partitions fast-fail behind it, and it fails the same way on #44089.

detail.title: [Fix] [AMD] kda: Match the fused verify Q/K norm to its reference kernel

files.patch:
@@ -378,8 +378,12 @@ def fused_kda_conv_gating_verify_kernel(
                     )
 
         if USE_QK_L2NORM_IN_KERNEL:
-            b_q = b_q / (tl.sqrt(tl.sum(b_q * b_q) + 1e-6))
-            b_k = b_k / (tl.sqrt(tl.sum(b_k * b_k) + 1e-6))
+            # Reciprocal then multiply, as fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update does:
+            # this kernel must match it bit for bit, and x / y is not x * (1 / y).
+            q_rsqrt = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(b_q * b_q) + 1e-6)
+            k_rsqrt = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(b_k * b_k) + 1e-6)
+            b_q *= q_rsqrt
+            b_k *= k_rsqrt
 
         b_q = b_q * scale
